title: SKE Crystal Pro Cola Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Please Note: These pods are not compatible with the SKE BAR device. Designed for use with the SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these SKE Crystal Pro 600 Prefilled Pods offer a hassle-free way to enjoy the brand’s signature flavours in a more sustainable format. Each prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 2ml of 20mg nic salt e-liquid, ensuring a smooth, flavourful mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw with rapid nicotine absorption. Cola Ice recreates the unmistakable taste of classic cola, blending deep caramelised sweetness with hints of citrus and spice for an authentic flavour. A crisp cooling exhale enhances the profile, delivering a refreshingly fizzy sensation that lingers with every puff. Swapping pods is effortless—simply remove the empty pod and replace it with a fresh one. Whether you're looking for an alternative to disposables or a convenient way to continue enjoying your favourite SKE Crystal Pro 600 flavours, these prefilled pods provide an easy and mess-free vaping experience.
